ledger.what: Carrier of the scoring reference depends on the chosen V1 member; conditional items
ledger.detail: 08 needs the carrier of whichever V1 member is chosen (O1 line/gate, S2 zone, P4 target player); 05 and 11.b are also conditional. No item can guard on another row's value or span rows. Holding it needs support conditioned on another line.

ledger.what: J2 cannot reference a performer role
ledger.detail: target_player's scoring reference is a P4 role, but J2 takes only object or region references. The fix is a new reference type on an existing field.

ledger.what: Episode team designations on static rows
ledger.detail: P3 [team=BUILD_OUT_TEAM / ATTACKING_TEAM] and J1/J2 [team=BUILD_OUT_TEAM]: a designation is evaluated 'at the trigger or episode it is attached to', and these items attach to none. Two readers may resolve them differently.

ledger.what: Non-claims with no row
ledger.detail: 'Whether opponents retreat' at restarts has no field for opponent placement on transitions. 'Touch limits' have no row for rules on player actions. Each needs a new field or row in an existing area.

ledger.what: Relative term 'own half (of team T)'

ledger.what: The goalkeeper requirement is a reading
ledger.detail: RPC-PROP-001 is a disjunction, and RPC-ID-004 says goalkeeper involvement is 'typical but not independently defining'. So 02 and 15.b are ASSUMED, and 03 rests on RPC-PROP-009's presupposition.

ledger.what: 'long clearance' versus SD-15's 'long kick'
ledger.detail: The authored term is 'long clearance' (RPC-PROP-132, -010); 'long kick' appears only in COACH_RULES. Under RC-34 a verbatim 'long clearance' is ENTAILED, not FREE(b), unless SD-15 is read to cover it.

ledger.what: The original contradicts itself
ledger.detail: It both non-claims and declares not-authored the same properties: how far beyond (O4/S5), shared or per team (J3), who restarts after out of play (T2/T5), and episode length (E4/V25). Both are recorded; NOT_AUTHORED bars free choice.

ledger.detail: S2 selects only by noun and functions, and 'wide' is a position. Items use noun=channel with OWN_INVOLVEMENT, which is circular for the items that entail the channels (02.a, 03, 08.d). Needs a new selector attribute (position class or contributing object) on an existing collection.

ledger.what: One channel per touchline cannot be required
ledger.detail: touchline-adjacent does not name which touchline and S2 has no side attribute, so 'one on each lateral side' is unheld; COUNT 2 alone allows both channels on one side. Needs a side selector attribute or per-touchline relative terms.

ledger.what: No field for a region's orientation
ledger.detail: ORIENTED exists but no region field takes an orientation; 'parallel to the axis' is no longer implied once WIDEZONE-07's full length is adapted. New field on an existing collection (regions[].orientation).

ledger.what: NOT_DOMINANT has no closed kind
ledger.detail: Needs the two channels' combined S6 widths to stay under E3: an aggregate across elements and rows. New requirement kind with the existing EXCLUDES relation. An S6 EXCLUSION of 'central' would be a stronger proxy, so it was not used.

ledger.what: One advantage from alternatives on different rows
ledger.detail: Multiplier and bonus sit on V7-V9, a free restart on V11-V13; RC-29 alternatives work only within one row, and REQUIRED items for the unchosen alternative read UNMET. LOCAL as a new collection like objectiveSets (live cardinality 1); STRUCTURAL if stage E reads it as changing derivation.

ledger.what: No predicate on a value-modifier condition
ledger.detail: V8a/V8b hold only type and referents; 'starts in' versus 'moves through' cannot be held for a multiplier or bonus. New field on an existing collection (a condition value, as V6 is for primary-event conditions).

ledger.what: This object's modifier cannot be addressed
ledger.detail: V7 selects only by condition.type, so 11.a (WHOLE_GAME) would bind any region-typed modifier from another object, and the V8a type line gets no item. New selector attribute (condition.referents or contributing object).

ledger.what: No field for an advantage's persistence or frequency
ledger.detail: V11 consequences have no end or cap; time windows end by duration, not by a trigger such as a possession change; nothing holds 'once per possession'. New fields on existing collections. Nothing is authored for them either.

ledger.what: No envelope row for area shape
ledger.detail: The non-claim on area shape has no row: EM-0001 owns Shape (EMD-0003, em-schema.v2.0-rc1.json) but the register holds only length and width. New row in an existing area.

ledger.what: RESTART missing from V13 effects
ledger.detail: Authored 'free restart' has no V13 value (draft list: ACCESS, COUNT_CHANGE); V26's list already has RESTART. Recorded as RESTART and derived as if listed (RC-33).

ledger.what: No trigger for an action starting in a region
ledger.detail: REGION_ENTRY holds 'moving through'; 'actions starting in' the channel has no trigger value on the draft list.

ledger.what: Touchlines as the long sides is assumed
ledger.detail: Original assumption #1; the source never defines touchline, and the register's relative terms use 'touchline' without tying it to S1.

ledger.what: Full-length channel is not authored
ledger.detail: 'Along both touchlines' fixes no length; the original cited it as authored. Restated ASSUMED.

ledger.what: Mark vs Zones optional
ledger.detail: setup_guidance 'Mark wide channels...' and contraindications 'Zones optional' sit in the same workbook record, unreconciled. Read broadly, 'Zones optional' makes the channels themselves optional, against 02.a/03 REQUIRED. The determinate boundary is assumed (#3).

ledger.what: Examples or closed alternatives
ledger.detail: '(bonus point, free restart, or scoring multiplier)' reads as examples or as closed alternatives. Kept TYPICAL_EXAMPLE as the original did, so all three are inert: no item makes a V7 value change explicitly authored for SD-06, and a multiplier derives NOT_AUTHORED (declared gap).

ledger.what: 'Exactly one mechanism' is assumed
ledger.detail: Original assumption #2; neither incentive_mechanism 'positional_or_scoring_advantage' nor the setup text says one rather than several.

ledger.what: Beneficiary is inferred
ledger.detail: Original assumption #5. ATTACKING_TEAM is the nearest canonical designation for 'the team performing the qualifying action'.

ledger.what: No second scoring route rests on SD-06
ledger.detail: The object's own text ('scoring or positional advantage', 'bonus point') can be read as a separate score. The exclusion comes from SD-06 plus an assumption, so 16.a and 16.b are ASSUMED.

ledger.what: Remaining non-channel space is assumed
ledger.detail: Original assumption #4: 'players can choose to use them or not' does not say playable space outside the channels remains.

ledger.what: Open, standing information is a reading
ledger.detail: visibility_effect 'increase' is authored but undefined, and the IE library has no visibility field. 17.a-d are ASSUMED. IE-D007 has no 'standing' value, so only V17 STANDING and V22 ALL are used.

ledger.what: 'Not compulsory' read onto V5

ledger.what: Magnitude, width scaling, symmetry and adjudication unauthored
ledger.detail: No multiplier size or bonus points (realization parameter fields null), no width function of field size, no channel or team ownership, and no rule for what counts as 'moving through' (ball, player, touch). The last is play-level, outside the boundary.

ledger.what: Persistence exists only as engine wording

ledger.what: Either/or between two whole layouts
ledger.detail: 'Two-goal or two-target field' means two of one kind. The âˆˆ selector also allows one goal plus one target, and the grammar has no alternative-of-items mechanism.

ledger.what: O2 kind 'target'
ledger.detail: Authored value 'target' is not in {ball, goal, line, gate}. It is recorded as authored.

ledger.what: 'target' is ambiguous
ledger.detail: It could be a line (fits line_crossed), a gate, a zone or a target player. Not authored.

ledger.what: Midline marker: object or region
ledger.detail: 'midline marker' could be an O2 line or a boundary between halves. I held it as S2 halves with perceptual-reference.

ledger.what: Selectors too coarse
ledger.detail: O1 selects only on kind, so a midline line cannot be told from target lines. V7 selects only on condition.type, so the two event modifiers cannot be addressed apart. Needs a new selector attribute.

ledger.what: No authored strictness
ledger.detail: setup_guidance and scoring_structure_type author no strictness or value status. The REQUIRED and PREFERRED_DEFAULT choices are mine.

ledger.what: 'High directional' degree
ledger.detail: The degree has no structural definition. Only orientation is held.

ledger.what: Teams, objectives and ends not authored
ledger.detail: opposition_structure is null. Two teams, one objective per team, and goals at opposite ends are all inferred from 'two-goal field'.

ledger.what: Unequal between teams
ledger.detail: 'Numerical asymmetry' is a relation across P2 elements. No requirement kind states 'differs' over PER_TEAM.

ledger.what: Permission conditioned on another object
ledger.detail: 'can be introduced ... when the goal is defending under overload' depends on a session goal. There is no condition field, and relationship rules only decide collisions.

ledger.what: 'in defending half'
ledger.detail: Unauthored whether players are confined to a half (region access or start placement) or this only describes where play happens.

ledger.what: Restarts largely unauthored
ledger.detail: The out-of-play stoppage appears only as an exception, with end line and touchline not distinguished. Who restarts, where and how (T2-T5) is not authored, nor is T6 for SCORE.

ledger.what: 'at any point': definition or default
ledger.detail: Unclear whether this forbids a region-bound transition trigger or only sets the default. Held as an EXCLUSION.

ledger.what: Event 'shot'
ledger.detail: 'shot' is not in the register's event or trigger vocabulary. It is recorded as authored in V8b.

ledger.what: Event sequence
ledger.detail: 'regain leading to shot' is an ordered sequence, but V8b holds an unordered set. Needs a new field on V7.

ledger.what: 'quick goal' not quantified
ledger.detail: The window start is assumed (POSSESSION_CHANGE). Duration, expiry effect and the magnitude of 'reward' are not authored.

ledger.what: Example-only existence
ledger.detail: RC-6 forces N/A on EXISTS items, so an existence the source gives only as an example cannot be marked TYPICAL_EXAMPLE. Only SUPPORTING softens it.

ledger.what: Links to other objects
ledger.detail: Recommending other objects and the GA-001 link are relations between objects, not game requirements. There is no relation to hold them; this may be deliberate.

ledger.what: Restart tempo
ledger.detail: 'chain into immediate live play' may imply a restart method (T5), but none is authored. Held OUTSIDE_BOUNDARY.

result.difficulties: Setup guidance gives no strictness, so REQUIRED vs PREFERRED was my call. Selectors cannot tell like elements apart (O1 kind, V7 type).
